obligations.description: Use one full sender package and independently configured receiver-local finite grants (DependencySet without ambient sender authority).
reached_assertions: full_pkg.format == 'git-repo-db/adr0031-exchange-v5'
len(full_pkg.context['repositories']) == 2
len(full_pkg.context['resources']) == 4
len(full_pkg.context['resource_repository_relations']) == 1
len(full_pkg.context['resource_relations']) == 1
len(full_pkg.context['repository_mapping_dispositions']) == 1
Receiver independently constructs DependencySet without ambient sender authority
Receiver grants strictly fence admitted units without inheriting sender permissions
obligations.durable_outcomes: Sender package is exported once with complete multi-entity payload; receiver configures local finite grants without reading or trusting sender authority.

obligations.description: Exercise empty, strict-subset and complete receiver selection on that same package.
reached_assertions: Empty receiver selection admits 0 context resources (report_empty.admitted_context_resources == 0)
Strict-subset receiver selection admits exactly 1 selected context resource (report_subset.admitted_context_resources == 1)
Complete receiver selection admits all 4 context resources (report_complete.admitted_context_resources == 4)
Report omissions record omitted entities under partial selections
obligations.durable_outcomes: The exact same exported package was imported across 3 independent receiver selections: empty selection yielded 0 rows; subset selection yielded exactly 1 repository and 1 resource; complete selection yielded all 2 repositories and 4 resources.

obligations.description: Verify exact admitted/omitted rowsets and accepted atomic-unit semantics in SQLite tables (repository_context, resource_repository_relations, resource_relations, etc.). Sender-side package narrowing is not receiver-selection coverage.
reached_assertions: Empty selection rowset: SELECT count(*) == 0 for repository_context, resources, resource_repository_relations, resource_relations, repository_mapping_dispositions, sources, source_repositories
Subset selection rowset: repository_context has [repo_a] (repo_b omitted), resources has [res_a1] (res_a2, res_b1, r_repo omitted)
Subset selection atomic units: resource_relations has 0 rows because rel_a1_a2 depends on unselected res_a2
Subset selection mapping claims: resource_repository_relations has 0 rows because r_repo was unselected

Complete selection rowset: repository_context has 2 rows, resources has 4 rows, resource_repository_relations has 1 row, resource_relations has 1 row, repository_mapping_dispositions has 1 row, sources has 1 row, source_repositories has 1 row
obligations.durable_outcomes: Receiver SQLite persistent state confirms exact rowsets matching selection and grants. Atomic-unit semantics strictly enforced: relations dependent on unselected members are omitted.

obligations.description: Exercise both Context-only (ExchangeService.import_package) and paired Core+Context (PairedAcquisitionCoordinator) import paths.
reached_assertions: report.context_imported is True and report.core_imported is False
core.sqlite3 does not exist on receiver and was not required
context.sqlite3 resources contains exactly 1 row for ctx_only_1
Paired coordinator admit_paired returns res.admission.core_committed is True and context_committed is True
Paired Core repositories table contains paired_repo
Paired Context repository_context table contains paired_repo and resources contains paired_1
obligations.durable_outcomes: Context-only package import succeeds cleanly in store without Core; PairedAcquisitionCoordinator coordinates atomic Core-first and Context-second persistence.

obligations.description: Pass a genuine handle issued by another authorization service into the product route.
reached_assertions: auth2.validate_context(adm1) raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
Context.transaction(catalog, authorization=auth2, admission=adm1) raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
ProviderAcquisition(catalog, authorization=auth2, admission=adm1).admit_batch() raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
PairedAcquisitionCoordinator(catalog, authorization=auth2, admission=adm1).admit_paired() raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
ExchangeService(catalog).import_package(pkg, authorization=auth2, admission=adm1) raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
Target SQLite stores have exactly 0 rows written (count == 0)
obligations.durable_outcomes: Handles issued by external ContextAdmissionService instances cannot be replayed across service instances; all product entry points fail closed with PERMISSION_DENIED and 0 writes.

obligations.description: Trigger permission revocation at actual transaction/COMMIT boundaries (not just a standalone lease.check_current() call).
reached_assertions: Context.transaction precommit lease check raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
Context.transaction cleanly rolls back on precommit failure (0 rows in repository_context, 0 rows in resources)
ExchangeService.import_package with cut hook during_context revokes policy, raising AdmissionFailure with cause code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
Receiver Context database has 0 rows in repository_context and 0 rows in resources after failed cut commit
obligations.durable_outcomes: Permission revocation at precommit boundaries triggers immediate rollback before SQLite COMMIT; no uncommitted or revoked mutations persist.

obligations.description: Verify exact replay and cached receipt behavior after revocation (assert fail-closed or receipt invariants).
reached_assertions: First import report: rep1.idempotent_replay is False
Second import report (authorized replay): rep2.idempotent_replay is True
Third import attempt after policy.grants revocation: raises AdmissionRefused with code == 'PERMISSION_DENIED'
Receiver state remains valid and uncorrupted after revoked replay refusal
obligations.durable_outcomes: Replay recognizes idempotency when authorized, but policy revocation strictly forbids shortcut bypass: replay attempts without active authority fail closed with PERMISSION_DENIED.

obligations.description: Verify Source, MappingClaim and Disposition permissions independently (assert rejection when each single permission is withheld while others are granted).
reached_assertions: Withholding Source: policy.lease raises PERMISSION_DENIED; import_package raises PERMISSION_DENIED; Context.transaction ctx.source raises PERMISSION_DENIED
Withholding MappingClaim: policy.lease raises PERMISSION_DENIED; import_package raises PERMISSION_DENIED
Withholding Disposition: policy.lease raises PERMISSION_DENIED; import_package raises PERMISSION_DENIED; Context.transaction ctx.admit_mapping_disposition raises PERMISSION_DENIED
Zero rows written to target tables under each withheld permission
obligations.durable_outcomes: Source, MappingClaim, and Disposition permissions are strictly orthogonal: withholding any single permission causes failure closed while all other permissions remain granted.

obligations.description: Execute authorized paired Provider acquisition and supported Core-first failure/recovery bookkeeping. Verify Core commit is durable, Context rolled back, and operational recovery state is tracked. Do not assume cross-store atomic rollback.
reached_assertions: AdmissionFailure outcome: core_committed is True, context_committed is False
core.sqlite3 repositories table contains repo_id (Core commit is durable)
context.sqlite3 repository_context does NOT contain repo_id and resources has 0 rows (Context is rolled back)
operational.sqlite3 request_continuations contains adr0030-partial record with {'core_committed': True, 'context_committed': False}
PairedAcquisitionCoordinator.admit_paired with injected Context failure confirms outcome.core_committed is True and context_committed is False
Cross-store atomic rollback is not assumed
obligations.durable_outcomes: Core commits first and remains durable upon downstream Context failure; Context cleanly rolls back; Operational ledger durably persists adr0030-partial recovery record.

obligations.description: Retain both Transfer SQL fences (i2_transfer_stage_fence, i2_transfer_report_stage_fence) and prove ordinary Transfer remains refused with UnsupportedResourceStage.
reached_assertions: sqlite_schema contains active trigger i2_transfer_stage_fence on resource_repository_relations
sqlite_schema contains active trigger i2_transfer_report_stage_fence on resource_relations
Both triggers contain 'I2_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED' in their SQL definitions
ProviderAcquisition.admit_batch(transfer_batch) raises UnsupportedResourceStage with 'Provider Transfer intake'
Direct SQL INSERT into resource_repository_relations aborted with I2_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED
Direct SQL INSERT into resource_relations aborted with I2_TRANSFER_UNSUPPORTED
0 rows inserted in both tables
obligations.durable_outcomes: SQL trigger fences are active and functional; application-level Provider acquisition refuses Transfer with UnsupportedResourceStage; direct SQL mutations are aborted by database triggers.
